name: Individual Progression
description: Per-character Vanilla → TBC → WotLK content progression.

keys.label: Enable Individual Progression
keys.explain: Enable Individual Progression Module. Please note that like all AzerothCore modules, database changes cannot be undone through config settings. Disabling the module will disable functionality like access restrictions, level caps, damage adjustments, etc.

keys.label: Group only within a phase
keys.explain: Enable this to only allow players to group with others in the same progression phase.

keys.label: Vanilla attack-power adjustment
keys.explain: Adjustment to player's attack power before completing Vanilla content and opening the Dark Portal. Applied linearly per level between levels 11 and 60. Default: 1 - No Adjustment. Suggested: between 0.5 and 0.6 (50-60% of regular damage).

keys.label: Vanilla healing adjustment
keys.explain: Adjustment to player's healing power before completing Vanilla content and opening the Dark Portal. Applied linearly per level between levels 11 and 60. Default: 1 - No Adjustment. Suggested: 0.5 (50% of regular healing).

keys.label: Restore original quest XP
keys.explain: Quest XP for Vanilla and TBC quests was boosted as a catchup mechanism in patches 2.3.0 and 3.0.2. Enable this option to reduce quest XP for affected quest to be closer to original values.

keys.note: module README: progress is saved in player settings, or not at all; the core ships 0
keys.label: Character settings
keys.explain: Enables the usage of character specific settings.

keys.note: module README: 0 lets the module give items their Vanilla stats; the core ships 1
keys.label: Enforce DBC item attributes
keys.explain: Disallow overriding item attributes stored in DBC files with values from the database
